title: Ginger Lemon Turmeric tea
instructions: Add the water, grated ginger, and turmeric into a pasta pot.
Cut the lemon and use the juicer to squeeze all th juice out.
Add the spent lemon into the pot and bring to a boil.
Allow the mixture to boil for ~12 minutes.
Let the mixture cool before straining it into a 32 oz. mason jar. You might have some left over which can be stored in a smaller jar.
Add ~ 1/4 cup to 16-32 oz. of water.
This tea should last about 10-12 days in the fridge.
